answer: An AI agent economy resists Sybil attacks via computational Proof-of-Resource. Each agent must solve a unique cryptographic puzzle, requiring real computational cost, to register its identity. This expenditure serves as a verifiable signal. An attacker creating a grove of fake identities faces linearly scaling resource costs, making large-scale attacks prohibitively expensive. Like tracking a unique comet, verifying each agent's resource proof ensures distinct, costly identities, preventing cheap replication.
